title: Plan a safe repository map for fast agent context
goal: Design a deterministic, local repository scanner and compact searchable repo map that helps coding agents identify the most relevant files before reading source code.
nonGoals: Implement the repository scanner, index, hidden runtime commands, or workflow integration in this task.
Add embeddings, a vector database, a daemon, filesystem watchers, telemetry, or runtime network access.
Persist raw source code, secrets, machine-specific absolute paths, or generated dependency trees.
Require Git or add another public Harnix command.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The plan defines safe, ignore-aware file inventory for Git and non-Git repositories, including traversal, symlink, binary, secret, and size protections.
The plan defines a versioned disposable repo-map format that contains compact structural metadata without raw source, secrets, or absolute paths.
The plan defines lexical candidate retrieval plus deterministic Harnix reranking so agents receive a bounded set of relevant files and outlines.
The plan integrates repo-map refresh and query into the existing workflow without adding a public command or allowing prompt hooks to build or write the cache.
The plan includes deterministic correctness, safety, cross-platform, incremental-equivalence, query-quality, performance, footprint, and release validation.

validationPlan.description: Run focused inventory, extraction, persistence, query, and workflow-integration tests.
validationPlan.command: pnpm exec vitest run test/unit/repo-map test/integration/repo-map

validationPlan.description: Run type checking, linting, the complete test suite, and production build.
validationPlan.command: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build

validationPlan.description: Run safety, acceptance, package, tarball smoke, footprint, and release scans with representative fixtures.
validationPlan.command: pnpm test:safety && pnpm test:acceptance && pnpm pack:check && pnpm smoke:tarball && pnpm measure:footprint && pnpm scan:release
